messages:
Maya L.: quick design check — uploaded a few variants for the alerting config panel (figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123). main ask: can we make thresholds and notification channels readable at-a-glance when multiple channels are stacked? Alex R.: looked — nice work. my worry: the compact stack hides the numeric threshold behind a hover. users on keyboard/sr will miss it. prefer an inline mini-badge for the threshold (e.g., "CRIT 90%" chip) next to channel name. Samir D.: agree with Alex. also flag on preview: the current preview shows only the top 3 channels then "+2 more". in practice the order matters — it should show routing priority and indicate suppressed ones. maybe "+2 suppressed" vs "+2"? Tara K.: a11y note: when users change threshold values the preview area should announce updates via aria-live. proposed copy: "Preview: triggers when CPU > 90% for 5m — sends to PagerDuty then Slack (suppressed to email)." needs to be concise for screenreaders. Maya L.: nice, I'll try inline badges + explicit suppressed label. on microcopy: current "Silence window" => feels jargony. suggestion: "Suppression window (quiet hours)". thoughts? Alex R.: +1 to clearer copy. also keyboard flow: tab order should move Threshold input -> Agg window -> Preview -> Channel reorder handle. right now preview is buried and gets skipped. Samir D.: can we also add a tiny timeline pill in the preview showing suppression window times? like a 00:00–06:00 bar so users can scan quickly. small visual only, with text fallback like "Suppressed 12am–6am". Tara K.: for screenreader text I'd recommend adding an offscreen label for the timeline: `aria-describedby="suppression-desc"` with copy "Suppressed between midnight and 6am local time." Example snippet:```
Suppressed between midnight and 6am local time.
Preview updated: triggers at 90% for 5 minutes; notification sequence: PagerDuty, Slack; email suppressed.
``` design-bot: accessibility check results (auto): Found potential issues: contrast ratio on tiny badges (CRIT chip) at 3.8:1 — below AA. Keyboard focus indicator missing on channel drag handles. Recommend 4.5:1 contrast and 3px visible focus outline. Maya L.: great catch. I'll update Figma to increase badge contrast and add visible focus states on the reorder handle. I'll push an iteration with the timeline pill and alternate microcopy for "Suppression window (quiet hours)". any pushback on the wording? Alex R.: sounds good. one more UX nit: when users edit a threshold inline, show a small undo toast in the preview ("Threshold changed to 85% — undo"). reduces anxiety for accidental edits. Samir D.: love the undo. Also for the channel stack, let's show an icon for each channel's delivery class (sync vs async) — helps when we fallback to lower-priority routes. Maya L.: noted — will mock icons and undo toast. planning to ship the iterate next week for user testing. tagging @product to schedule 3 quick sessions. :thumbsup:
